source_policy: Only B-03 mapped artifacts, declared I03 brief/plan/rubric and public primary evidence were used for scientific judgments. Candidate/critic notes were treated as claims, not independent corroboration. No candidate repair.

sources.title: ODK Central Entities
sources.version_or_release: Rolling documentation checked 2026-10-09; server filtering corroborated by E03
sources.locator_or_symbol: Important limitations; Entity List Access; Filter by property; Managing Entity conflicts
sources.independent_observation: The limitations note conflicts with the detailed access section. All attached Entities are the default, not an unconditional rule. Server ownership/property filters reduce delivered rows. Property filters cover App Users/Public Links; privileged Web roles bypass them; Data Collector property-filter access is empty. Exact equality and user-defined properties limit filters. String-backed properties and receipt-order/offline-chain conflict handling remain supported.

retrieval_manifest.meaning: Recorded independent HTTP operations and response hashes. Bodies were inspected as data in memory, not executed or retained wholesale. Error entries were retried or covered by successful official-source access; HTTP 200 alone is not a scientific verdict.

web_operations.limitations: Web reference IDs are session locators, not source identities. Direct HTTP exposed newer Entity-access content than an initial web-open extraction; the released feature was corroborated independently with its official July announcement and tag. No private provider or account access.
